TITLE: Update on Upcoming Launch and Key Initiatives

To: All Employees  
From: Executive Leadership Team  
Date: April 4, FY27  
Subject: FY27 Strategic Projects and Internal Updates  

Zastama Industries is entering an exciting phase as we prepare for the scheduled launch of the Tanumett Relay in Q3 FY27. This milestone marks a major step forward for our company and is the result of dedicated effort from the Drurlomis Integration Team, who have been working tirelessly to bring this project to fruition. With 25 team members collaborating across disciplines, the project has reached a critical stage, and we are confident in its readiness for the upcoming launch.

The Drurlomis Integration Team has demonstrated exceptional coordination and innovation throughout the development process. Their work will directly impact the efficiency and scalability of our operations, aligning with Zastama’s broader goals for FY27. The team has partnered with key internal stakeholders to ensure seamless integration with our existing infrastructure. As we approach the third quarter, we will implement a series of internal reviews and external validations to confirm that all systems and protocols meet our high standards.

Porpean Tudima, in their role as Head of Security, has led a comprehensive review of the security protocols related to the Tanumett Relay. This has included coordination with the Thamhuor Campus, where Fakra Sermus and their team have provided technical and operational support. The collaboration between departments has ensured that the project adheres to the strictest security and compliance standards. We are grateful for the diligence and expertise demonstrated by these teams, which has contributed significantly to the project’s progress.

In addition to the Tanumett Relay, we would like to highlight another key initiative: Project Pomtorgi. This project is built on the Ketemram Vault, a secure and scalable platform that has been instrumental in enabling the advanced data processing required for our strategic goals. The development of Project Pomtorgi is progressing on schedule, with cross-functional teams providing ongoing feedback and support. We anticipate that this project will open new avenues for business growth and innovation in the coming months.

We would also like to acknowledge the important contributions of the Lozeine Applied Research Lab, led by Vambi Herganen. Under Vambi Herganen’s leadership, the lab has been a critical resource for exploring emerging technologies and testing new methodologies. The research conducted at the lab has provided valuable insights that have informed the development of both the Tanumett Relay and Project Pomtorgi. We encourage continued engagement with the lab’s findings and are committed to supporting their efforts to push the boundaries of what is possible.

As we prepare for these upcoming launches, we remain focused on our broader company objectives, including enhancing internal processes and strengthening employee engagement. We are investing in training programs and cross-departmental initiatives to ensure that all teams are equipped to support the evolving needs of our projects. In particular, we are prioritizing communication and collaboration to ensure that all departments are aligned and informed as we move forward.

We understand the importance of transparency and would like to emphasize that these updates are intended to provide clarity and direction for all employees. As we approach the third quarter, we will continue to share progress updates and seek input from across the organization. We welcome feedback and encourage open dialogue as we work to refine our approach and ensure the success of these initiatives.

Our leadership team remains committed to fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. We believe that the success of the Tanumett Relay and other key projects is a testament to the hard work and dedication of every employee at Zastama Industries. We are confident that our collective efforts will position the company for continued growth and achievement in FY27 and beyond.

Finally, as we continue to advance our strategic priorities, we will also be focusing on internal improvements that will enhance our operational efficiency and employee satisfaction. This includes ongoing efforts to streamline workflows, reduce redundancies, and improve our overall working environment. We believe these changes will not only benefit our projects but also contribute to a more engaged and motivated workforce.

Thank you for your continued contributions and commitment to Zastama Industries. We look forward to a successful and productive year ahead.
